scope: Public operating facts for the existing six-company mooring cohort. Actual owners, vessels, positions, assets, permits, dates, rates and decisions must be entered by the operator.

facts: Current invite-only beta for harbor authorities, installers and cove masters.
Published owner/vessel/anchor/permit records, GPS mapping, inspections, assigned field jobs and town-review progression.
Published CSV import/export; no exact machine header contract or public import API is provided on the reviewed pages.
buyer.boundary: The companion exports complete editable source and an explicit mapping worksheet. It does not claim to have imported into MooringOps, submitted to a municipality, dispatched a crew or sent a message.

facts: Spring work includes buoy, pendant and pickup gear inspection/preparation/installation and harbormaster service notifications.
Fall exchanges the summer assembly for a winter buoy, with summer gear removed, cleaned and stored.
The page describes annual Duxbury permits and prior harbormaster approval before installation, relocation and changes in boat or ownership.
Its approximate three-year chain/shackle replacement expectation is condition-dependent and not a guaranteed service life.
operators.application: Link actual permit decision to the selected mooring and job; record each physical component move and customer notice separately.

facts: Service area includes Mattapoisett and Dartmouth.
Winter removes and stores ball/pennant and installs a winter stick; spring reverses that assembly and stores the winter stick.
Hauled inspection includes weight/tackle, measurements and photographs, needed repairs and return to station.
The company describes three-year inspections in its service area and coordination with harbormasters.
operators.application: Retain selected inspection method, measured values/units, original evidence, linked repair and separately recorded town handoff; choose the actual jurisdiction per mooring.

facts: Publishes spring installation/fall removal, diving/inspection, cleaning, repair and storage.
Its installation uses the coordinates on the mooring permit and existing sub-meter GPS equipment.
Supports multiple anchor/system types and custom design supplied by its professionals.
operators.application: Store original position notation, datum/source and permit reference. Do not compute anchor sizing, convert unidentified coordinate formats or invent positioning precision.

facts: Published mooring service covers Bourne and Falmouth.
Annual programme includes buoy preparation/storage/lettering, town permit-number checks twice per year, seasonal assembly exchanges and its stated inspection cycle.
Six named rental harbors describe location categories, not six physical moorings.
The same page still labels shop promotions and hours Winter/Spring 2025.
operators.application: Create actual dated jobs and separately identified components; do not infer current shop availability or a mooring inventory from the site.

facts: Installation, maintenance, inspection, removal and winter storage of moorings and adjacent float docks.
Inspection can be in-water diving or hauling for a closer look.
Published component supply and buoy preparation support separate gear and work records.
operators.application: The operator selects dive/haul and the actual work/evidence; float docks remain a distinct asset category outside this mooring record.

facts: New moorings and services in the named New Meadows, Kennebec, Sheepscot and Sasanoa rivers.
Full lift/clean/inspection includes components and a report for the actual municipality.
Repairs and replacement parts are billed separately; repair work uses time and materials.
Seasonal service exchanges markers; the separate 300 seasonal-client statement concerns broader float/ramp work.
operators.application: Keep inspection/report, completed repair/parts/time and manual municipal submission distinct. Known part totals exclude unentered prices and do not infer labor charges or an invoice.

facts: New and renewal applications use the linked LynxLog service.
The current page gives June 15 for renewal, with stated later fees; these dates and fees belong to Brunswick only.
Harbormaster review precedes the emailed payment link.
municipal_sources.implementation: Keep the external portal/reference and authority decision separate from contractor field completion. No automatic fee/deadline engine.

facts: Review Property, Owner and Vessel sections and upload the boat photograph.
Record customer acceptance and save for review.
Returned issues lead to corrected resubmission; approval permits payment via the supplied link.
municipal_sources.implementation: Create a returned submission's successor with a reference to its preserved predecessor; retain actual issues and evidence.

facts: Registration/email link leads to a new mooring application.
Property, Owner and Vessel are completed before saving for harbormaster review.
Payment follows approval.
municipal_sources.implementation: Use a new application only when appropriate to the actual asset/authority. The companion records the external action; it does not transmit it.

facts: The page states three-year inspections by authorized installers/inspectors.
Its displayed 2026 numeric group is literally 501 - 100; nearby prose also retains a spring 2024 reference.
municipal_sources.implementation: Retain the contradiction. Do not assign a due-year cohort from that table; obtain the actual permit/authority schedule for the entered mooring.

municipal_sources.retrieval: indexed official PDF text; direct request returned 403
facts: Indexed official text describes annual mooring applications and permits tied to the identified vessel.
municipal_sources.implementation: No unseen PDF clause is used as a software default. The current Mattakeesett first-party service page separately supports the approval-before-change discussion.

source_boundaries: All six company identities remain separate; alias domains remain in the original commercial profile, not copied as personal customer data.
Published operator inspection/replacement wording is not a universal engineering interval.
No actual mooring count, crew availability, permit approval, payment or external send is inferred.
Photographs and technical observations are entered evidence. The app does not certify engineering adequacy or navigational safety.
